findings.passage: I believe it is important to point out that democratic forms of government rely on citizens having faith in the electoral process, and in my opinion this legislation will ensure that the people of Wisconsin have full confidence in the security and integrity of Wisconsin elections.
findings.note: January 13, 2025 press release from his office on the photo ID constitutional amendment (April 1, 2025 ballot question). He says the amendment would support confidence in election security.

findings.passage: It is clear that there is a large majority of Americans from all walks of life support voter ID requirements and we want to make sure that we are up with the times in our state.
findings.note: Same press release. He cites a 2024 Pew poll and says voter ID requirements have broad public support.

findings.passage: For clarification sake; this is already required according to Wisconsin State Statute but this amendment would put it in the Wisconsin Constitution so a court couldn’t find it unconstitutional.
findings.note: Same press release. He explains that photo ID is already in state law and the amendment would move it into the constitution.
